title: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard: export day-level Copilot metrics
summary: The export behaviour, default, licensing prerequisites and policy commands are supported by Microsoft documentation and the supplied notice. The policy routes need their target selections included, and two governance checklist items have no corresponding control row; these are minor corrections.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans day-level export of row-level Copilot Dashboard metrics for reporting and deeper analysis.
claims.quote: This feature enables users to export fresher row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis at day level.

claims.claim: The export policy route is Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Access setting, with the app and feature selection supplied in its note.
claims.quote: select Viva from the settings menu. ... Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access. ... Select Create a policy. ... select the app and feature ... Select the Access setting option
claims.fix: Make the target selection already supplied in the note part of the route: 'Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Viva Insights > Copilot Metrics Export > Access setting'. Retain the note that Learn calls the setting 'User-level export and insights'.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy with ModuleId VivaInsights, the retrieved FeatureId, Name, IsFeatureEnabled $false and Everyone creates a tenant-wide disabling policy.
claims.quote: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -FeatureId <String> -IsFeatureEnabled <Boolean> -ModuleId <String> -Name <String> ... [-Everyone] ... $false: The feature is not enabled by the policy.

claims.claim: The web-app policy route is Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Access setting, with the target web-app feature supplied in its note.
claims.quote: Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access. ... Select Create a policy. ... Name the policy and select the app and feature ... Select the Access setting option
claims.fix: Include the target selection already supplied in the note: 'Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Viva Insights > Viva Insights web app > Access setting'.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone disables the web app for the tenant.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant ... ModuleId : VivaInsights FeatureId : Viva Insights web app Name : DisableFeatureForAll IsFeatureEnabled : false Everyone
